title: fix(rest): a failed saved-dataset read on the dataset door answers 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, not 404
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9HLWFFbydxZ9SpmExahzcbB)_
Fixes #31774

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据集查询接口（`POST /analytics/dataset/query`，按名称查已保存数据集）在“读取已保存数据集”这一步本身失败时，现在回答 503「服务暂不可用」，不再回答 404「数据集不存在」。
- 为什么改：原来读取失败被当成空列表，元数据后端故障时仪表盘会告诉用户“数据集不存在”，用户可能误删或重建；运维在日志里只看到 404 而看不到故障。AI 工具 `query_dataset` 对同一失败已回答 503，两个入口现在一致。
- 风险与回滚：只影响读取抛错这一条路径；读取成功但没有该名称仍是原样的 404，找到则照常查询。回滚即还原 `analytics-routes.ts` 一处改动。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts`（数据集读取的 try/catch 一段）、`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts` 与 `packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-ai-tools-parity.test.ts`（新增的 describe）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/analytics-routes.test.ts src/analytics-dataset-ai-tools-parity.test.ts`，预期 25 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts` read the saved datasets with `p.getMetaItems?.(datasetRequest).catch(() => null)`, so a read that threw became an empty list and the door answered `404 {"code":"NOT_FOUND","message":"Dataset \"X\" not found."}`.

Now a throwing read is turned into a declared refusal (`code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'`, `status: 503`, `refusal: true`, `cause` = the read's own error) and thrown into the handler's existing catch. That catch already answers every producer-declared 5xx through `declaredServerFaultAnswer` (`@objectstack/types`), and its `logError` runs before that arm, so:

- the client gets `503 {"error":"The dataset \"X\" could not be resolved: the dataset read failed. This is a server-side fault, not a missing dataset.","code":"SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE"}`;
- the store's own text (a driver or connection message) is withheld from the client, as for every 5xx at this door, and reaches the operator log through `cause`.

Same code and status as the AI tool `query_dataset` (PR #31772, `dataset-tools.ts`) for the same failed read. Its sentence is built inline there and not exported (re-read on `main` after #31772 merged), and `packages/services/service-analytics/**` is outside this card's surface, so there is no shared wording to import yet. This door uses the same sentence without the parenthetical store text (withheld here; see open question 1 in the report).

Unchanged:

- A read that succeeds and lacks the name: `404 {"code":"NOT_FOUND","message":"Dataset \"X\" not found."}`, byte-identical (pinned with `toEqual` on the whole body).
- A found dataset: served as before.
- A protocol with no `getMetaItems` method: today's answer is that same `404 NOT_FOUND` (optional chaining reads no list). Kept and pinned.

### Other door reads in `analytics-routes.ts` (seat ruling 3)

Checked every `catch` in the file on `e253f3ab`:

| Site | Shape | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| saved-dataset read (was line 199) | `.catch(() => null)` then `404 NOT_FOUND` | fixed here |
| `resolveService` (line 108) | `catch { return undefined; }` then `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` "not available on this deployment" | **out-of-scope finding**: a throwing environment resolution or analytics provider (environment kernel not acquirable) answers 501 "not available" rather than an outage status. The file's header comment states this posture as deliberate for #30011 ("or could not be acquired, the answer is the 501 below"). Not changed; named for the seat. |
| dataset schema parse (line ~289) | `catch (verr)` then `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` | correct: a parse refusal, not a read |
| handler catch (line ~304) | classification arms | the arm this fix routes through |

No other `.catch(() => null)` exists in the file.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the existing harness file `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts` (no new file):

- `answers 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, not 404, when getMetaItems throws`: status 503, `code`, the sentence's first clause, no "not found" anywhere in the body, the store text (`ECONNREFUSED`) absent from the body, the original error reaching `console.error` as `cause`, and `queryDataset` never called.
- CONTROL: a read that succeeds without the name → the whole 404 body, byte-identical.
- CONTROL: a read that finds the name → 200, served.
- CONTROL: a protocol without `getMetaItems` → the same 404 body.

And one parity pin in `packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-ai-tools-parity.test.ts` (the four-face harness #31772 landed), as its own top-level `describe`: with the same thrown read, the REST door and `query_dataset` (through the tools' `execute`, on the real `AnalyticsServicePlugin` service) both refuse `{ status: 503, code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE' }`, and the two answers are equal.

Test edits to existing harness code, named:

- `analytics-dataset-ai-tools-parity.test.ts`: the `protocol` double built in `beforeAll` is now a module-level `let` (was a `const` inside `beforeAll`), so the new case can make one read throw with `mockRejectedValueOnce`. Every existing case is unchanged and green.
- `analytics-routes.test.ts`: a module-top `import '@objectstack/objectql';` (the convention `check:test-source-alias` names for an edited test file whose server under test reaches objectql through a handler's dynamic import; precedent `email-send-door-bounds.test.ts`). No assertion changed.

## Acceptance notes

- The 503 body has this door's declared-5xx shape (`error` + `code`), the one it already gives any producer-declared 503, while the door's hand-built 4xx refusals (the 404 included) use `code` + `message`. Choosing the shared arm over a hand-built `{code, message}` 503 keeps one classification for every declared 5xx at this door. Open question 2 in the report.
